starters.name: grazer
starters.description: A sprout mouth and a roomy stomach: built for grass and fruit, the commonest food.

starters.name: nectar-sipper
starters.description: A long proboscis and a nose tuned to nectar: finds scarce, rich food by smell, with no side thrusters.

starters.name: fungus-scraper
starters.description: A rasping radula and a filtering intestine: eats the toxic fungus the others avoid.

starters.name: scout
starters.description: An eye on a stalk with a narrow, far-reaching view and three long tails: fast and sharp-sighted, with little in reserve.

starters.name: tank
starters.description: Armour plating and a fat reserve behind two strong tails: slow, tough, and hard to starve or hurt.

starters.name: hunter
starters.description: The grazer with a hinged jaw: bites creatures as well as plants, and runs at smaller ones. Starts as a small group among the founders.

starters.name: omnivore-sprout
starters.description: The grazer with a hinged jaw beside its sprout mouth: grazes grass and fruit and bites creatures too. Starts as a small group among the founders.

starters.name: omnivore-mandible
starters.description: The grazer with a mandible for any plant and a hinged jaw for creatures: eats everything. Starts as a small group among the founders.

starters.name: tailer
starters.description: The grazer with its mouth on the tip of a flagellum at its nose.
